source: feedbacks/Fine Tuning AI for Daily Bites - 2.pdf (Torrent Pharma feedback email, Jul 3 2026)
note: Torrent's Key/Other labels are reference material, not immutable ground truth (client confirmed they are 'not sure' all 35 assignments are correct). Items with ambiguous=true were flagged during the categorization rubric review as contradicting or only loosely matching CODEX's provisional rubric; treat mismatches on those items as lower-confidence signal pending client calibration.

examples.title: Novo Nordisk Wegovy semaglutide approved in India for adolescents with obesity
examples.text: Novo Nordisk's Wegovy semaglutide has been approved in India for use in adolescents aged 12 years and older with obesity, expanding its indication beyond adults. The once-weekly GLP-1 therapy supports significant weight loss. The approval addresses rising obesity among Indian teens and opens a new patient population.

examples.title: FDA approves Tremfya guselkumab label update for psoriatic arthritis joint damage
examples.text: The FDA approved a label update for TREMFYA guselkumab to include evidence of inhibiting structural joint damage in adults with active psoriatic arthritis. Phase 3b APEX study showed significant reduction in joint damage progression. TREMFYA is now the only IL-23 inhibitor with this benefit, strengthening its first-line position.

examples.notes: CODEX rubric called this 'borderline Key' (established antibiotic, geographic launch only).
examples.title: Cumberland launches Vibativ telavancin in China after regulatory approval
examples.text: Cumberland Pharmaceuticals launched Vibativ telavancin injection in China following regulatory approval and a partnership with SciClone. The antibiotic treats serious Gram-positive infections including MRSA and hospital-acquired pneumonia. The launch expands access in a major market facing antimicrobial resistance.

examples.title: Junshi toripalimab Phase III NEOTORCH meets primary endpoints in NSCLC
examples.text: Junshi Biosciences announced Phase III NEOTORCH trial met primary endpoints EFS and MPR, demonstrating significant efficacy in perioperative treatment of resectable stage II-III NSCLC and plans sNDA submission. Already approved in China for multiple oncology indications.

examples.title: FDA approves AstraZeneca Imfinzi durvalumab with BCG for bladder cancer
examples.text: The FDA approved AstraZeneca's Imfinzi durvalumab with BCG for BCG-naive high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer. The Phase III POTOMAC trial showed a 32% reduction in recurrence, progression, or death versus BCG alone. This is the first new therapy in over 30 years for this setting.

examples.notes: Exceptional-case test of the Priority-Review guardrail: Indian company + Orphan Drug + Fast Track + strong Phase IIb/III evidence. Repo unit test (test_exceptional_indian_priority_review_can_be_key) asserts this must be Key even though Priority Review is normally Other.
examples.title: Zydus saroglitazar gets FDA Priority Review for primary biliary cholangitis
examples.text: Zydus Therapeutics received US FDA Priority Review for NDA supported by Phase IIb/III EPICS-III trial showing 56.7% vs 9.8% biochemical response in primary biliary cholangitis. Not yet approved; holds Orphan Drug and Fast Track designations for this rare autoimmune liver disease.

examples.title: Sanofi Venglustat receives FDA Priority Review for Gaucher disease
examples.text: Sanofi's investigational drug Venglustat received FDA Priority Review for treating type 3 Gaucher disease, decision expected November 2026. Phase III LEAP2MONO showed positive efficacy on neurological symptoms. If approved it would become the first US therapy targeting neurological manifestations of this rare disease.

examples.title: Nestle Health Science and IdB sign licensing agreement for VOWST in Europe
examples.text: Nestle Health Science and IdB Holding signed a licensing agreement to develop and commercialize VOWST in Europe, pending EMA approval. VOWST is an oral microbiota-based therapy approved in the US to prevent recurrent C. difficile infection. The collaboration aims to expand access in Europe.

examples.title: Pfizer and Innovent sign global licensing deal worth up to $10.5 billion
examples.text: Pfizer and Innovent Biologics signed a global licensing deal worth up to $10.5 billion to develop 12 early-stage cancer therapies. Innovent will lead early development, with Pfizer taking over global trials and commercialization. The deal includes $650 million upfront and milestone payments.

examples.title: Brazil Anvisa approves Ozivy first semaglutide injector pen from EMS
examples.text: Brazil's regulator Anvisa approved Ozivy, the country's first Semaglutide-based injector pen developed by EMS, following patent expiry in Brazil. Production will take place in Sao Paulo with large-scale capacity targeting market expansion. Commercial launch depends on pricing approval.

examples.notes: Directly Torrent-relevant (Torrent's own India entry plan) - a miss here is high-cost regardless of overall score.
examples.title: Torrent Pharma plans India entry of resmetirom MASH therapy post patent expiry
examples.text: Torrent Pharma plans India entry of US-approved MASH therapy resmetirom (first-in-class) post patent expiry; currently conducting Phase III trials in India, with potential launch 12-18 months after expiry. Already US FDA-approved for non-cirrhotic MASH with fibrosis; no innovative therapies currently available in India, indicating strong unmet need.

examples.title: Sobi olezarsen Phase III CORE analysis shows pancreatitis and triglyceride reduction
examples.text: Sobi reported Phase III CORE/CORE2 analysis showing ~85% reduction in acute pancreatitis risk and ~66% triglyceride reduction at 6 months in severe hypertriglyceridemia. Already approved for FCS in US/EU; US FDA priority review for sHTG and EMA label extension under review, indicating expansion beyond rare indication.

examples.notes: CODEX rubric explicitly recommended Other (Phase II, designation-only) - this is a direct contradiction with Torrent's Key label. Needs client calibration.
examples.title: Autobahn elunetirom receives FDA Fast Track for bipolar depression
examples.text: Autobahn Therapeutics received US FDA Fast Track designation for adjunctive treatment of bipolar depression, indicating potential to address significant unmet need. Being evaluated in Phase II AMPLIFY-BD ongoing trial with topline data expected Q2 2026; also in Phase II for MDD.

examples.title: Precigen Papzimeos receives FDA orphan drug exclusivity for respiratory papillomatosis
examples.text: Precigen received US FDA orphan drug exclusivity (7 years, till Aug 2032) for recurrent respiratory papillomatosis. Already US FDA-approved (Aug 2025) as the first and only therapy for adult RRP; currently marketed in the US.

examples.title: Dizal sunvozertinib gets China NDA acceptance with Priority Review for NSCLC
examples.text: Dizal received NMPA China NDA acceptance with Priority Review for first-line treatment of EGFR exon20ins NSCLC based on Phase III WU-KONG28 showing significant PFS benefit. Already approved in US and China for previously treated EGFR exon20ins NSCLC; holds Breakthrough Therapy Designation.

examples.notes: CODEX rubric called this 'borderline Key' (strategically meaningful portfolio build) - contradicts Torrent's Other label. Needs client calibration.
examples.title: Eli Lilly acquires Curevo, LimmaTech and Vaccine Company for infectious disease
examples.text: Eli Lilly announced acquisition of Curevo, LimmaTech Biologics, and Vaccine Company to strengthen its infectious disease portfolio, focusing on preventive vaccine-based strategies. Deal size up to $3.8Bn total.

examples.title: Gujarat Themis Biosyn to acquire MicroBiopharm Japan for Rs 1300 crore
examples.text: Gujarat Themis Biosyn to acquire 100% stake (~Rs 1,300 Cr) in MicroBiopharm Japan to strengthen global CDMO and fermentation-based biotech capabilities. MBJ operates across proprietary pharma and CDMO services with no specific product-level approvals highlighted.

examples.title: Skymap Pharma to acquire state-run IMPC for Rs 121 crore
examples.text: Skymap Pharma is set to acquire state-run Indian Medicines Pharmaceutical Corporation for Rs 121 crore. The deal aims to strengthen its presence in the domestic pharma market. It reflects ongoing consolidation in India's pharmaceutical sector.

examples.notes: Known scorer bug: contains the word 'generic' (market commentary, not a generic-drug approval) and gets force-demoted by the routine-generic guardrail even at a high score. See scorer._determine_key_highlight.
examples.title: India GLP-1 market momentum slows due to price war
examples.text: Multiple Indian pharma companies see GLP-1 market momentum slow due to price war including innovator price cuts, weak patient retention, and prescription plateauing. Generic semaglutide launched post-patent expiry; market ~Rs 1,900-2,000 crore now moderating. Companies cutting sales targets 25-30%, inventory build-up over Rs 100 crore, delaying new launches.

examples.title: Pfizer Ibrance palbociclib gets FDA approval for HER2+ metastatic breast cancer
examples.text: Pfizer received US FDA approval for palbociclib in combination with trastuzumab and endocrine therapy as maintenance treatment for HR+, HER2+ metastatic breast cancer. Approval based on Phase III PATINA study showing ~24% reduction in risk of disease progression/death. Already approved globally for HR+, HER2- disease; now expanded to HER2+.

examples.notes: India launch by a global originator - Torrent-relevant geography.
examples.title: Eli Lilly launches selpercatinib in India after CDSCO approval
examples.text: Eli Lilly launched selpercatinib in India post CDSCO approval for RET-altered locally advanced/metastatic solid tumours including NSCLC and thyroid cancers. Oral targeted therapy demonstrating rapid durable responses including CNS activity. Globally approved selective RET inhibitor; now introduced in India.

examples.title: FDA approves Keytruda plus Trodelvy as first-line for PD-L1+ TNBC
examples.text: Merck and Gilead received US FDA approval for Keytruda plus sacituzumab as first-line treatment for PD-L1+ advanced/metastatic TNBC. Phase III KEYNOTE-D19/ASCENT-04 showed ~35% reduction in progression/death risk with improved PFS (11.2 vs 7.8 months). First PD-1 inhibitor plus Trop-2 ADC combination in TNBC.

examples.title: Ionis olezarsen receives FDA approval for severe hypertriglyceridemia
examples.text: Ionis Pharmaceuticals received US FDA approval for olezarsen for severe hypertriglyceridemia to reduce triglycerides and pancreatitis risk. Phase III CORE/CORE2 showed up to ~72% TG reduction and ~91% reduction in acute pancreatitis events, positioning as first targeted therapy with blockbuster outlook over USD 2bn peak sales. Previously approved for FCS.

examples.title: Eli Lilly Jaypirca pirtobrutinib gets positive CHMP opinion for CLL
examples.text: Eli Lilly received positive CHMP opinion for EU approval of pirtobrutinib for chronic lymphocytic leukemia across all lines of therapy. Based on Phase III BRUIN CLL-313/314 trials demonstrating strong efficacy of non-covalent BTK inhibitor. Already US FDA-approved for relapsed/refractory CLL/SLL and mantle cell lymphoma.

examples.title: J&J Tecvayli teclistamab gets EMA CHMP recommendation for multiple myeloma
examples.text: Johnson & Johnson received EMA CHMP recommendation for label expansion of teclistamab in combination for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. Phase III MajesTEC-3 showed ~83% reduction in progression/death risk and OS benefit. Teclistamab approved in EU for heavily pretreated RRMM.

examples.notes: CODEX rubric leaned Key (material safety/regulatory development with direct commercial consequences) - contradicts Torrent's Other label. Needs client calibration.
examples.title: Amgen Tavneos avacopan EMA CHMP recommends revocation of authorisation
examples.text: Amgen's EMA CHMP recommended revocation of EU marketing authorisation for avacopan for rare autoimmune vasculitis due to unfavourable benefit-risk profile. Decision linked to safety concerns including drug-induced liver injury. Regulators advise no new patients. Previously approved for ANCA-associated vasculitis.

examples.title: Biocon and Duopharma secure Rs 450 crore insulin contracts from Malaysia
examples.text: Biocon and Duopharma secured insulin supply contracts worth over Rs 450 crore from Malaysia's Ministry of Health. The agreements include multi-year supply of recombinant insulin, insulin glargine and insulin aspart. These contracts aim to improve access to affordable insulin.

examples.title: Alembic receives FDA final approval for generic oseltamivir oral suspension
examples.text: Alembic Pharmaceuticals received US FDA final approval for generic oral suspension of oseltamivir phosphate for influenza treatment. Reference drug Tamiflu widely approved globally for treatment and prophylaxis of influenza.

examples.title: Lupin receives FDA tentative approval for generic abiraterone acetate
examples.text: Lupin received US FDA tentative approval for generic abiraterone acetate for prostate cancer treatment (mCRPC indication). Reference drug Zytiga widely approved globally for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.

examples.title: Government of India plans to tighten oversight of pharma packaging materials
examples.text: Government of India plans to tighten regulatory oversight and quality compliance for pharma packaging materials. Packaging currently governed under Drugs & Cosmetics Act with varying quality controls across suppliers.

examples.title: Gilead Trodelvy sacituzumab gets European Commission approval for 1L TNBC
examples.text: Gilead Sciences received European Commission approval for sacituzumab for first-line metastatic triple-negative breast cancer in PD-(L)1 ineligible patients. Already approved in over 60 countries for later-line mTNBC; this marks first ADC use in 1L TNBC in EU. Based on Phase III ASCENT-03 showing 38% reduction in risk of progression/death.

examples.title: Upsher-Smith launches Kymbee deflazacort oral suspension for DMD
examples.text: Upsher-Smith Laboratories launched an oral suspension formulation of deflazacort for treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy in patients aged 2 and older. Already approved indication for DMD in US; new formulation expands administration options alongside existing tablets.

examples.title: Antares Therapeutics and Novartis enter up to $1.9B precision cancer collaboration
examples.text: Antares Therapeutics and Novartis entered a collaboration worth up to ~$1.9B to develop precision cancer therapies. Includes $105M upfront plus milestones. Programs are preclinical/early-stage, leveraging Antares' discovery platform to target undruggable oncology pathways.

examples.title: Eli Lilly completes acquisition of Centessa for neuroscience portfolio
examples.text: Eli Lilly completed acquisition of Centessa to strengthen its neuroscience portfolio, particularly sleep-wake disorders including narcolepsy. Centessa brings a clinical-stage pipeline of orexin receptor 2 agonists. Deal value ~$1.4 billion total including contingent value rights.

examples.title: Eli Lilly and Abbisko enter $1.9B R&D collaboration for small molecules
examples.text: Eli Lilly and Abbisko Therapeutics entered a ~$1.9B R&D collaboration for discovery and early development of small-molecule therapies across multiple targets. Programs are preclinical/early-stage; Abbisko to lead discovery with milestone-linked payouts.
